title: Totality Path & Nearby Locations
description: Maps and data for watching total solar eclipses: every populated place in the path of totality, using NASA's Besselian elements. For each place the dataset gives the duration of totality, local times, the Sun's altitude, the distance from the centre line and, closer to each date, historical cloud cover. It covers eleven total eclipses from 2017 to 2035. Interactive version: https://eclipse.aravpanwar.com/
